mostWorthwhile.text: Making the wicking lettuce bed was worthwhile: it showed how fabric can draw solution upward without another pump.

leastWorthwhile.text: Planting the lettuce felt fairly predictable once its bed was ready, though it was satisfying progress.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the foil-backed cloth shades developing tubers while leaving the shoots exposed to light.

arbitrary.text: The foil and fabric combination initially lacked a clear purpose, but its result explained the potato cover.

continue.text: Yes. The crop-specific preparations gave practical details I found interesting, and I would be curious to see what happens as the plants grow.
